goal: Config parity: (1) upward-walk discovery from root for .slop.toml or pyproject[tool.slop] (was: only <root>/.slop.toml); (2) scope-keyed ignore exemptions (global [ignore] keyed functions/classes/modules/packages; validated; unknown keys raise), suppression plumbed into the dispatcher matching a finding's component kind+qualname; (3) slop schema subcommand generating the config shape from the registry (more honest than a drift-prone committed asset — it cannot drift). Legacy src/slop/config/ as oracle.

summary.title: Config parity: discovery, scope-keyed ignore, generated schema
summary.what: Upward-walk config discovery (.slop.toml / pyproject[tool.slop]); scope-keyed [ignore] exemptions validated at load and suppressed in the dispatcher via AnalysisConfig.is_ignored; slop schema subcommand generated from the registry. 5 config-parity tests. Suite 187.
summary.why: Closes the config gap (was only <root>/.slop.toml, no ignore, no schema). Generating the schema from the registry is more honest than a drift-prone committed asset.
summary.user_goal: Config parity: (1) upward-walk discovery from root for .slop.toml or pyproject[tool.slop] (was: only <root>/.slop.toml); (2) scope-keyed ignore exemptions (global [ignore] keyed functions/classes/modules/packages; validated; unknown keys raise), suppression plumbed into the dispatcher matching a finding's component kind+qualname; (3) slop schema subcommand generating the config shape from the registry (more honest than a drift-prone committed asset — it cannot drift). Legacy src/slop/config/ as oracle.

decisions.rationale: A registry-derived schema cannot drift from the rules it describes; the legacy needed a v1.json + drift-guard test precisely because it was hand-maintained.
rejected: Commit a v1.json asset + drift guard (reintroduces drift risk)

decisions.chose: Match on the finding's component (kind + qualname)
decisions.rationale: Cleanly exempts per-altitude units (the bulk of verdicts); corpus-altitude rules disable via enabled=false.
rejected: Per-metadata-symbol matching (metadata keys vary per rule; messy)

decisions.rationale: install bundles hook/skill assets the v3 tree does not yet carry — structurally N/A until those are ported.
